english.title: Possess prohibited rifle with a chamber from which empty cartridge cases are extracted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without authority, possessed a rifle, namely **(..SPECIFY RIFLE..), with a chamber from which empty cartridge cases were extracted using energy

(A)_[from]_
(B)_[imparted to a spring or other energy storage device by]_

propellant gas
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ag) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: Manufacture of such a weapon is covered under H20251, purchase/acquire under H20249 and the sale/transfer of such under H11538.

other.penalty:
Indictment only: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to offences committed on or after 6th April 2022, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
